reason: A discussion-control plugin that preserves user goals, boundaries, decisions, and focus while guiding complex conversations toward evidence-based recommendations and actionable next steps.

summaries.zh: 用于复杂讨论的控制插件，可持续维护目标、边界、决策与当前焦点，并将讨论收敛为有依据的建议和可执行下一步。
summaries.en: A discussion-control plugin that maintains goals, boundaries, decisions, and focus while helping complex conversations converge on evidence-based recommendations and actionable next steps.

capabilities: Maintains structured discussion state and checkpoints
Writes Markdown and JSON checkpoint files to the workspace
Supports subagent model selection and spawning
Provides a discussion status rail in compatible web interfaces
